gloss: going to bed late; staying up late

definitions.gloss: going to bed late; staying up late
definitions.explanation: Describes the habit or act of going to sleep at a late hour.

examples.japanese: {遅寝|おそね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Going to bed late is bad for your health.

examples.japanese: {遅寝|おそね}⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I've been keeping up a lifestyle of going to bed late and waking up early.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅寝|おそね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Children's late bedtimes have become an issue.

notes:
Combines ⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ (late) and {寝|ね} (sleep). Describes going to bed at a late hour, as opposed to ⟦{早寝|はやね}→早寝：12994_hayane⟧ (going to bed early). Often used in discussions about sleep habits, health, and children's routines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遅寝|おそね}{遅起|おそお}き: going to bed late and getting up late
- {遅寝|おそね}⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧: going to bed late and getting up early
- {遅寝|おそね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧: habit of staying up late

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夜更|よふ}かし→夜更かし：07693_yofukashi⟧: staying up late — more common in everyday conversation, often implies doing something fun
- ⟦{早寝|はやね}→早寝：12994_hayane⟧: going to bed early — the antonym
- ⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧: sleep deprivation — the result of not getting enough sleep
